items.title: Splunk Enterprise Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks Days After Disclosure
items.description: CISA has given federal agencies only three days to patch CVE-2026-20253, which can be exploited for unauthenticated remote code execution. The post Splunk Enterprise Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks Days After Disclosure appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Authorities Dismantle SocGholish Malware Network — 106 Servers and 101 Domains Seized
items.description: Authorities have dismantled the criminal infrastructure behind SocGholish, one of the most persistent malware frameworks active since 2017, seizing 106 servers and 101 domains while remediating nearly 15,000 infected websites worldwide. The coordinated takedown was executed as part of Operation Endgame, launched in 2024 and recognized as the largest international operation ever conducted against…

items.title: New iPhone BootROM Vulnerability Exposes Apple SoCs to Full Chain-of-Trust Compromise
items.description: A novel BootROM vulnerability, dubbed usbliter8, affects Apple devices powered by A12, S4/S5, and A13 SoCs. The exploit chains a hardware-level bug in the Synopsys DWC2 USB controller with a firmware configuration flaw, enabling full application processor boot-chain compromise with no software patch possible due to the immutable nature of BootROM code. items.title: Hackers Breached Klue Integration to Steal Salesforce CRM Data via OAuth Tokens
items.description: Threat actors exploited a trusted third-party SaaS integration to silently harvest enterprise CRM data, marking the latest chapter in an escalating wave of OAuth-abuse attacks targeting Salesforce ecosystems. items.title: Hackers Can Leverage SQL Server 2025 AI Features to Exfiltrate Sensitive Data
items.description: Hackers are increasingly finding new ways to abuse legitimate enterprise features, and Microsoft SQL Server 2025’s newly introduced AI capabilities are now raising serious security concerns.
